name: uvvr
description: Turn partly unverifiable AI outcomes into explicit, executable evaluation packages.

interface.shortDescription: Build executable evals for fuzzy AI outcomes
interface.longDescription: Identify an AI system's unverifiable reward, convert it into explicit V4–V1 criteria, and generate a design contract, evidence runbook, and executable evaluator.
defaultPrompt: Design an executable eval for my AI system.
Turn this fuzzy reward into verifiable criteria.
Create an eval package for this agent workflow.
